title: Agent Status Protocol (ASP): A Lightweight Specification for State Reporting in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Agent Status Protocol (ASP) defines a lightweight way for heterogeneous AI agents to report their operational state to a status server, and for observers such as dashboards to receive that state as soon as it changes. Agents push small JSON events over HTTP POST; the server exposes the aggregated state to observers over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Because an agent that has crashed, hung or been compromised cannot be trusted to report its own failure, ASP does not rely on self-reports alone: the server infers liveness from missed heartbeats, can detect agents that are alive but no longer making progress, and accepts observations from supervisors, guardrails, operators and peers, some of which take precedence over what the agent says about itself while others are shown alongside it. translated_title: 智能体状态协议（ASP）：一种用于多智能体系统状态报告的轻量级规范
translated_abstract: 智能体状态协议（ASP）定义了一种轻量级方式，使异构AI智能体能够向状态服务器报告其运行状态，并使仪表盘等观察者能够在状态发生变化时立即接收该状态。智能体通过HTTP POST推送小型JSON事件；服务器则通过服务器推送事件（SSE）向观察者公开聚合后的状态。由于已经崩溃、挂起或被攻陷的智能体无法被信任去如实报告自身故障，ASP并不单纯依赖自我报告：服务器通过缺失的心跳来推断存活状态，能够检测出虽然存活但不再取得进展的智能体，并接受来自监督者、防护栏、操作员和同级智能体的观察结果，其中一些观察结果优先于智能体对自身的描述，另一些则与其一并展示。ASP沿相互独立的维度（生命周期、健康、任务、底线、治理）对状态进行建模，使得一个智能体可以同时处于例如在线、降级、工作中……
tldr: 提出了智能体状态协议（ASP），一种轻量级的多智能体系统状态报告规范，它不依赖智能体自我报告，而是通过心跳缺失推断存活状态、检测“存活但停滞”的智能体，并结合监督者、防护栏等第三方观察结果，沿多个独立维度刻画智能体的真实运行状态。
en_tdlr: ASP is a lightweight status-reporting specification for multi-agent systems that avoids relying solely on agent self-reports by inferring liveness from missed heartbeats, detecting alive-but-stalled agents, and incorporating third-party observations with precedence rules across independent state dimensions.
